title: A Salt for the Sigil Again
premise: Yara Yarrow has hidden her gift behind harmless charms for seven years, but the crown's new witch-hunt forces her to flee toward a border that was erased from every map. Guided by a smuggler she once loved and bound by an oath to keep the sigil-gate sealed, she must choose between reopening the door that destroyed her family or dying in a country determined to burn its own magic out. In the end, Yara sacrifices her own gift—pouring it into the gate so it opens once, for everyone hunted like her—and walks through powerless but free.
about_author: Jude Winterbourne is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. They write about borders, oaths, and the people who pay for both.

chapters.title: Charms for a Burning City
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. She sells a luck-charm to a frightened fishwife as royal criers announce the gift-hunt, then burns her stock and prepares to run. A childhood friend turned crown inquisitor recognizes her at the market but hesitates to report her. The beat is dread sharpening into resolve: invisibility was always an illusion.

chapters.title: The Road That Isn't There
chapters.summary: Yara's POV, with interludes from smuggler Dain Kestrel. She bargains passage with Dain, the man she loved before the gate took her family, and they travel a road only visible at dusk. Pursued by inquisitors led by her old friend, they find the erased border marked by her mother's sigil. The beat is reluctant reconnection and rising hope.

chapters.title: What the Gate Remembers
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. At the gate, she learns it demands a keeper's full gift to open—the same price her mother paid. Her inquisitor friend arrives not to arrest her but begging passage for his own hidden daughter, forcing Yara to weigh duty against mercy as soldiers close in. The beat is heartbreak: love against duty, with no clean choice.

chapters.title: A Salt for the Sigil
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. She salts the threshold, speaks her inheritance aloud, and pours seven years of hoarded power into the gate, opening it one final time for every hunted soul behind her. Powerless, she steps through last, hand in Dain's. The beat is grief transmuted into freedom: survival finally shared instead of bought alone.
